title: VisualGasic
description: VB6-style event-driven programming language for Godot 4. Features include a WYSIWYG form designer, x86-64 JIT compiler (2x-118x faster than GDScript), IntelliSense, debugging, profiler, and 40+ drag-and-drop controls. Write game logic in .vg files with automatic event wiring. Cross-platform: Linux, Windows, macOS.
